title: Chọn phong cách cho app tập luyện
question: Kết quả bốc thăm là Tuyến Metro. Giữ hướng này, chọn một phương án khác, hoặc bốc lại.

options.label: Tuyến Metro
options.lineage: Hanoi metro wayfinding: line strips, station dots, platform signs
options.thesis: Your week is a metro line: training days are stations, the streak is how far the train has run.
options.viewport: Header shows the streak as stations passed; under it this week's line Mon to Sun with today's station lit orange; below, today's workout as a list of stops with minutes, plus a Start button.
options.risk: If the line is decorative instead of carrying the state, it reads as a theme skin.

raised.raise: Orange is used only for the current station or the exercise you are doing now. Finished stations turn solid, upcoming ones are hollow.
Every stop carries its minutes, right-aligned, and the session adds up to its 45:00 budget.
During a set the rep target is set huge so it reads from the floor, with tiny labels: hierarchy by scale contrast alone.
Each calorie number shows its formula on tap: 3.5 MET x weight x minutes.
History stacks past weeks as lines at the same scale, so weeks compare at a glance.

options.label: Lịch Bloc
options.thesis: Every day is one sheet with a giant numeral; finishing a session tears the sheet off.
options.viewport: Today's sheet takes the top half: huge red date, workout name, minutes and kcal; below, a strip of the week's sheets, torn ones marked done.
options.risk: Familiar: calendar metaphors are where most habit apps land.

options.label: Màn hình dọc
options.thesis: During a session one exercise fills the whole screen, and the next is one swipe away.
options.viewport: Exercise name and sets bottom-left, a rail of done/rest/skip glyphs on the right, a giant rep count in the middle.
options.case: Wins audience identification and in-session clarity; the week view and streak have no natural home.
options.risk: Feels like a video app with no video; the overview screen falls back to generic.

options.label: Orienteering
options.thesis: The session as a course of numbered controls in purple.
options.viewport: A course map of today's exercises.
options.case: Loses both axes: obscure to this user and a weaker version of the metro line.
options.kept: One colour reserved for the active leg only.

options.label: Cassette J-card
options.thesis: Workout A and B as side A and side B of a 45-minute tape.
options.viewport: Today's side as a tracklist with running times.
options.case: Loses audience identification; clarity no better than the line.
options.kept: Running times right-aligned and budgeted to the session length.

options.label: Type specimen
options.thesis: The rep count as a giant glyph that thickens with each set.
options.viewport: One huge numeral and a slider.
options.case: Loses both axes: a design-nerd world, not a trainee's.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone for the in-session rep target.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.thesis: Push-up progression as plates of one plant growing.
options.case: Loses both axes: too slow and soft for a training tool.
options.kept: Fixed scale so stages and weeks compare directly.

options.label: Monochrome product
options.thesis: Neutral scale, one accent, every claim paired with proof.
options.case: Loses both axes: a marketing form, generic as an app.
options.kept: Every number paired with its proof.

canonCard.label: Kiểu app fitness quen thuộc
canonCard.thesis: Dark cards, activity rings, a blue accent: what fitness apps ship, done cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: A ring summary on top, this week's cards, a Start button.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other fitness app by design.
